name: R and J Berry Farm
tagline: Link to R and J Berry Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/RandJBerryFarm
description: R and J Berry Farm is a small farm in Bloomfield, MO. It grows Blueberries, with seasonal availability through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
